📲 Phone bridge — MacroDroid + Shizuku + WhatsApp

This site can't reach your phone directly. It triggers your phone via MacroDroid cloud webhook: https://trigger.macrodroid.com/[device-id]/[macro]. Your phone then auto-sends WhatsApp / SMS / runs Shizuku shell. Needs internet + Play Services on phone.

Phone log appears here…
Setup on phone (5 min) — tap to open

A. MacroDroid webhook: Install MacroDroid → Add Macro → Trigger: Webhook (URL) → Identifier: wa_send → copy base URL above. Action: UI Interaction → WhatsApp → send {lv=message} to {lv=to}. Or simpler: Action: Open URL https://wa.me/{lv=to}?text={lv=message} + UI click Send. Add 2nd macro followup + 3rd delivery same way.

B. Params: Webhook query ?to=220…&message=hello auto-creates variables [lv=to], [lv=message]. Limit 3800 chars. Device needs internet.

C. Shizuku (no root, for power): Install Shizuku (shizuku.rikka.app) → start via Wireless Debugging → in Shizuku authorize MacroDroid → in MacroDroid use Constraint: Shizuku State = Running before shell actions. Re-start Shizuku after every reboot. Use for: auto-start Shizuku on WiFi, silent SMS, shell toggles.

D. WhatsApp warning: MacroDroid uses UI automation, NOT official API. Use WhatsApp Business, only message customers who ordered / opted-in, max ~30-50/day manual pace, keep human delay 5-10s. Spam = ban. For scale later use WhatsApp Cloud API instead.
